assertion.statement: For the actual complex abelian surface, rational algebraic endomorphisms identify with endomorphisms of its polarizable rational Hodge structure.
assertion.objects: The actual D210 surface A, its covariant H1(A(C),Q), rank-one left B action and right complex structure J; likewise its conjugate A_sigma.
assertion.hypotheses: The object is a complex abelian surface. The independent centralizer and algebraic-closure descent arguments are not supplied by this source.
assertion.quantifiers: For each actual surface and every rational Hodge endomorphism; all endomorphisms, not just those preserving the chosen polarization.
assertion.parameter_range: Complex abelian varieties up to isogeny, Hodge types (-1,0),(0,-1); the current application is the non-CM D210 surface.
assertion.uniformity: No varying-field or effective uniform bound is supplied.
assertion.constants: No degree, conductor or height constant.
assertion.normalizations: Covariant H1 and Hom tensored with Q; a polarization is an existence condition on objects, not a restriction to polarization-preserving morphisms.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The object is a complex abelian surface. The independent centralizer and algebraic-closure descent arguments are not supplied by this source.
assertion.limit_order: First compute the rational Hodge centralizer, select the non-CM branch, then use algebraicity and the separate geometric descent.

assertion.statement: For the two specified embeddings of the same quadratic field in the actual quaternion algebra B over Q, an invertible b implements j(x)=b^-1 i(x)b for every field element x.
assertion.objects: The quaternion algebra B/Q=End^0_Qbar(A), abstract quadratic F and specified embeddings i:F→B and j=f^-1 i_sigma f:F→B.
assertion.hypotheses: Both embeddings have the same identified characteristic-zero quadratic domain and land in B. The earlier proof that End^0(A)=B and the geometric isogeny f are independent inputs.
assertion.quantifiers: For these embeddings there exists an invertible b implementing their specified field identification on every x.
assertion.parameter_range: Quadratic subfields of the characteristic-zero quaternion algebra B/Q.
assertion.uniformity: Existence for each pair only; no uniform degree or coherent choices in sigma.
assertion.normalizations: j=b^-1 i b and g=f b^-1; quasi-homomorphisms are rationalized Hom. Positive integer denominator clearing is a separate elementary step.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Both embeddings have the same identified characteristic-zero quadratic domain and land in B. The earlier proof that End^0(A)=B and the geometric isogeny f are independent inputs.
assertion.limit_order: Obtain f and full End=B first; conjugate the specified embeddings, then clear denominators. Same-L descent, compatibility, cocycles, Q-descent and quantitative bounds are separate.

available_assertion.statement: Any specified isomorphism between quadratic subfields of a quaternion algebra over Q is implemented by an inner automorphism by an invertible element.
available_assertion.objects: A quaternion algebra B over Q, quadratic field subalgebras F1 and F2, and a specified Q-algebra isomorphism F1 to F2.
available_assertion.hypotheses: F1 and F2 are embedded quadratic subfields of the same central simple quaternion algebra; the identification is a Q-algebra isomorphism.
available_assertion.quantifiers: For every such specified isomorphism there exists b in B^* inducing it on every element of F1.
available_assertion.parameter_range: Quaternion algebras and quadratic subfields over Q.
available_assertion.uniformity: Existence for each pair only; no uniform degree or coherent choices in sigma.
available_assertion.normalizations: Conjugation by an invertible element; either inverse convention is obtained by replacing b by its inverse.
available_assertion.exceptional_cases: Does not assert integral conjugacy, coherent choices or quantitative bounds. Only the characteristic-zero separable subfield case is used.
available_assertion.limit_order: No application-specific isogeny or descent construction is included.
